phases.name: Refuse unknown, stray, duplicate and valueless command-line options

steps.name: Regression tests: mistyped or misplaced options are refused and nothing is written (RED)
criteria: Each reproduced mistake exits 1 through the real CLI, prints its named code on stderr, and leaves the workspace digests identical with no receipt, ledger or output file written: --dryrun, --dry_run, -n and --dry-run=true (cli.unknown-option); --dry-run <path> in both positions and a stray positional (cli.unexpected-argument); a duplicated option (cli.duplicate-option); --merge --dry-run, --report --dry-run, --out with no value and a bare --target (cli.missing-value)
A typo'd subcommand (bild --in <dir> --out <file>) exits 1 with cli.unexpected-argument and does not create the output file

auth --targt sheets and ingest --complete x / --complet exit 1 with cli.unknown-option or cli.unexpected-argument as named, before any credential read, and leave the cache and coverage state untouched
The refusal text names the subcommand and the offending token and lists the valid options, so --dry-run appears in the detail for a mistyped build flag
A bare --target no longer reports build.unknown-target; it reports cli.missing-value

Positive guard: build --out <new file> --dry-run on a synthetic cache exits 0, prints a plan and writes nothing; plan-fetch with valid options exits 0 and prints its window; each other subcommand's valid line is accepted with its options read at the given values
A property test over every subcommand's option table shows any option name absent from the table is refused, and any valid combination of table options parses to exactly the given values
CLI cases run the real CLI in a subprocess inside an isolated temp workspace with a synthetic cache and an empty HOME; no operator credential or network is touched
Against the current CLI the refusal cases fail because the run exits 0 and writes or proceeds, not because of a missing fixture or helper
The step ends at RED: the failing tests are not committed on their own; the crafter logs RED and proceeds in the same dispatch to step 01-02, whose COMMIT covers both steps
steps.scenario_name: a mistyped, stray, duplicated or valueless command-line option is refused with a cli.* code and nothing is written
steps.implementation_notes: Style of rebuild-refuses-existing-out.test.mjs; reuse aWorkspace/isolatedWorkspace, writeJson, aMessage, fileDigests and runHarvest (with cwd and an empty HOME) from tests/acceptance/job-alert-harvester/support/domain-types.mjs. Fixture per RCA: .cache/messages/2026-07/1.json from aMessage({}), seed t.xlsx via build --out t.xlsx, add a second message so a real merge would change t.xlsx. Table-driven with it.each over the RCA rows (docs/feature/fix-reject-unknown-options/rca.md, Regression tests table); every refused case asserts exit 1, code in stderr, digests of the whole workspace identical, no .cache/receipts, no ledger. Assert on exit status, stderr text and digests only. The pure parseCommandLine tests (fast-check property: names outside the table are refused; valid combinations round-trip to the given values) import src/core/cli-options.mjs and live in the same file or a sibling under tests/regression/job-alert-harvester/; they fail RED because the module does not exist. Guard the table against cli.md drift only if cheap; the RCA's docs-synopsis test is optional and out of scope here. Docs updates (cli.md, refusals.md, how-to) belong to the wave-boundary docs check, not these steps.

steps.name: Fix: parse every command line through strict per-subcommand option tables (GREEN)
criteria: The step-01-01 regression and property tests pass

Every subcommand and the rebuild form declares its option set as data (value options and flags); an option outside it, a single-dash token or a --name=value spelling is refused as cli.unknown-option, and the detail always lists the valid options
A boolean flag never consumes the next token; a stray positional argument, including a typo'd subcommand falling into the rebuild form, is refused as cli.unexpected-argument
A repeated option is refused as cli.duplicate-option; a value option with no value or followed by another option is refused as cli.missing-value, including a bare --target
A mistyped option may carry a did-you-mean hint; the valid options are listed regardless
Parsing happens before any read or write: a refused command line changes nothing, and the rebuild form's refusals print like the other subcommands' and exit 1

build, fetch, auth, import, plan-fetch, ingest and the rebuild form behave identically for valid input, and every existing test passes unmodified; if any existing test would be refused, stop and report it instead of editing it
src/core stays pure (no node: imports, no classes, no mutation) and npm run check:arch and the layering test stay green
The old guesswork parser is deleted and no call site reads options through it
The single commit for steps 01-01 and 01-02 carries trailers for step 01-02
steps.scenario_name: a mistyped, stray, duplicated or valueless command-line option is refused with a cli.* code and nothing is written
steps.implementation_notes: New pure module src/core/cli-options.mjs: per-subcommand option tables as data plus parseCommandLine(subcommand, argv) returning { options } or raising a coded refusal (same shape refuse produces: message leads with the code, error carries code). Tables per RCA: rebuild form in/out; plan-fetch source/from/to/batch; ingest raw/window/expect + flag complete; build out/merge/report/target + flag dry-run; fetch source/from/to; auth target; import from. One table per subcommand, not per mode, so build --out x --target sheets still reaches build.target-conflict and build --target drive still yields build.unknown-target. Check order per token: unknown name, duplicate, value presence, then flags never consume. Where the four codes live: crafter's call, default is a small CliRefusal enum in src/core/cli-options.mjs (the RCA's recommendation, keeps the parser self-contained); putting them in src/core/sheets-refusals.mjs next to BuildRefusal is the alternative, and sheets-refusals.mjs is listed in files_to_modify only in case the crafter takes it. State the choice in the commit message. Wire the call sites in src/cli/harvest.mjs (~l.535-543); the rebuild branch's parse call moves inside its try so the catch prints error.message. Simplify targetOf/isGiven (~l.154-155) now that a bare --target is cli.missing-value. Keep the exit-2 usage path for a missing --in/--out unchanged. Callers may keep reading options.flags.has('dry-run') style names, or the crafter may adapt the returned shape, provided run* behaviour is unchanged. Docs updates (cli.md:21-24, refusals.md, how-to troubleshooting row) are outside these steps and belong to the wave-boundary docs check.
